lightIdle: Ṅwalani adreseni iṅwe na iṅwe ya webusaiti. Ri khou ṱola mutevhe washu wa zwitshosetso, tshivhumbeo, u tevhedza merka, DNS na phindulo ya zwino. Kha Ima: bvelani, khwaṱhisedzani nga tshikona tsha mulayo tshine no tshi fulufhedza, naho ni tshi ḓivhadza arali ni tshi ṱoḓa.
lightLimited: Zwo kunaho zwi amba uri u ṱola ho itwaho a hu ngo ṋea tsivhudzo khulwane — a si fulufhedziso ya uri saiti yo tsireledzea.
privacyNote: Zwo dzwiaho: a hu vhulungwi tshithu. U ṱola vhukhakhi hu thusa u khwinisa thaidzo dza thekiniki fhedzi — hu sa vhe adreseni, nahone hu sa vhe u andadza phanḓa.
privacyPolicyIntro: buusdo Cybersecurity Service Tool (mutevhe wa zwibveledzwa zwa Buusdo — tshibveledzwa tsho fhambanaho) i thusa u ṱola adreseni ya webusaiti ni sa athu i fulufhedza. U ṱola hu shumisa zwiga zwashu na mutevhe washu wa zwitshosetso wo langiwaho. Siaṱari heli ndi ndivhadzo ya tshidzumbe ya tshibveledzwa ya webusaiti, kateloso ya bhurauza, na app ya teseke.
privacyPolicyWhatTitle: Zwine u ṱola hu zwi shumisa
privacyPolicyWhatBody: Musi ni tshi ṱola, adreseni ine na i ṅwala i shumiswa kha seva ya buusdo u sekaseka tshivhumbeo, u i linganya na mutevhe washu wa zwitshosetso, nahone nga u nanga u ṱola u swikelelea ha zwino (DNS / HTTP). A ri rumeli URL dzo ṱolwaho kha Google Safe Browsing kana kha dziṅwe API dza mbuelo dza tshumelo ya vhuraru, nahone a ri rengisi datha ya u ṱola.
privacyPolicyStoreBody: Zwo dzwiaho: a hu vhulungwi tshithu. Ni nga nanga u vhulunga kha tshishumiswa itshi fhedzi (mutevhe wa u thivhela/u fulufhedza, hisitori ya u ṱola nga u nanga) kha bhurauza, kateloso, kana app ya teseke. U ṱola vhukhakhi ha thikhedzo hu katela fhedzi tshiko na lushaka lwa tshitshosetso — hu sa vhe adreseni yo ḓalaho, nahone hu sa vhe u andadza kana u rengisa.
privacyPolicyAccountTitle: A hu na u ṱanana ha akhaunthu ya gomo
privacyPolicyAccountBody: buusdo a i ṋei akhaunthu ya gomo kana u ṱanana ha mutevhe vhukati ha zwishumiswa. Mutevhe wau wa u thivhela/u fulufhedza u sala kha tshishumiswa itshi. I tshimbidzeni nga u bvisa/u longela JSON kana QR ya shield-lists-v1, kana ni ṱananye iṅwi faela ya shield-backup.json ya teseke (USB, Drive, Syncthing).
privacyPolicyContactBody: Kha mbudziso dza tshidzumbe kana dza tshibveledzwa, kwamani na mushumi wa u longela ha buusdo nga imeili yao ya mulayo kana tshikona tsha thikhedzo (muthu kana tshumelo tshine tsha shumisa Cloudflare Worker). Nangani adreseni iyo ya mulayo ye na no i ḓivha — hu si luṱingo kana imeili yo ganḍwaho kha saiti ine na i ṱola. Ni songo nambatedza mvelelo dza u ṱola dza tshiphiri kha zwikona zwa lushaka.
privacyPolicyLimitsBody: A hu na u ṱutululwa ha TLS — HTTPS CONNECT ndi dzina la host fhedzi; a hu na satifikheithi ya MITM. A hu na u vhulaha ha zwitirwa — zwitirwa zwine zwa khou shuma zwi bvela phanḓa. Folda dza sisiṱeme ndi muvhigo fhedzi — /usr, /etc, ndila dza sisiṱeme dza Windows, na Program Files a dzi tshimbidzwi kana dza lulamiswa. A hu na enzhini ya AV kana ya zwiga, nahone a hu na u fara phaswede kana hisitori ya u bhrawuza.

feedbackFalsePositive: Folaga yo khakheaho — ṅwalwa lwa tshiga tsho khakheaho
feedbackDraftsAfterReport: Nga murahu ha ṅwalwa lwa u ḓivhadza Ima: swaiyani mutevhe fhasi, bvisani batches/*.json, nga murahu mushumi a shumise npm run threat:apply. A hu rumiwi tshithu u bva kha bhurauza iḽi.
feedbackNeedLocal: Nangani Tshishumiswa itshi fhedzi kana U ṱola vhukhakhi ha thikhedzo kha Nzudzanyo u vhulunga ṅwalwa dza mbuno.
feedbackAlready: Zwo no vha kha ṅwalwa dza hayani.
feedbackDraftsNote: Hayani fhedzi. Swaiyani mutevhe fhasi, bvisani JSON kha security/data/batches/, nga murahu npm run threat:apply.
feedbackExportPlan: I ḓo ṅwala host dza {hosts}: {add} u engedza, {remove} u bvisa. Sedzulusani faela phanḓa ha u shumisa.
feedbackEmpty: A hu athu vha na ṅwalwa dza mbuno.
partialPackBanner: Mañwalo manwe a re maṱuku a Tshidzumbe na Nzudzanyo a kha ḓi vha nga Luisimane kha luambo ulu. Zwipiḓa zwa Chrome na zwa Ima zwo phindulelwa.
localeRecommendBody: Hu tshi tevhelwa bhurauza yanu, ri eletshedza {lang}. Ni nga zwi shandula tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe kha thoho.
whyEmpty: A hu na zwiga zwa nungo nnṱha ha mielano yo doweleaho.
levelCriticalNote: Vhuṱanzi ho tiwaho hu sumbedza uri ni tea u bvela phanḓa ha u ṅwala mafhungo.
levelHighNote: Zwiga zwinzhi zwa tsivhudzo zwo ṅwalwaho zwi ṱoḓa u lavheleswa nga u ṱavhanya.
levelCautionNote: Ho wanala u sa vhofholowa ho hulaho kana zwiga zwa tsivhudzo.
levelLowEvidenceNote: A hu na tshitshosetso tsho ḓivheaho tsho wanalaho kha zwiko zwo ṱolwaho.
levelUnknownNote: A hu na vhuṱanzi ho linganaho u swika kha khakhelo yo vhofholowaho.
reputationNoKnownMatch: A HU NA U ELANA HO ḒIVHEAHO
recommendationLeaveAndBlock: Bvelani nahone ni thivhele domain hei (kha kateloso kana app ya teseke)
desktopBlockNeedOpen: Vulani app ya teseke ya buusdo u thoma (localhost:3010), nga murahu ni lingedze hafhu.
evidenceKnownThreatDetail: Adreseni hei yo elana na mutevhe wa zwitshosetso wa buusdo.
evidenceNoMatchTitle: A hu na tshitshosetso tsho ḓivheaho kha mutevhe
evidenceNoMatchDetail: A hu na tshitshosetso tsho ḓivheaho tsho wanalaho kha mutevhe washu. Hezwi a zwi khwaṱhisedzi uri saiti yo tsireledzea.
evidenceUnknownReputationDetail: Mutevhe washu a u ṋei mvelelo yavhuḓi kana yavhi.
evidenceProviderUnavailableTitle: Mutevhe wa zwitshosetso a u wanalei
evidenceProviderUnavailableDetail: Mutevhe washu a wo ngo kona u vhalwa. U ṱola ha tshivhumbeo na ha zwino zwo bvela phanḓa.
evidenceIdentityMatchTitle: Domain i elana na tshumelo yo ḓivheaho
evidenceIdentityMatchDetail: Domain ine ya ṅwaliswa i elana na {name}. Hezwi a zwi ambi uri saiti yo tsireledzea.
evidenceIdentityMismatchTitle: I vhonala sa tshumelo yo ḓivheaho, fhedzi domain a i elani
evidenceIdentityMismatchDetail: Adreseni i vhonala i tshimbilelana na {name}, fhedzi domain i langaho ndi {domain}.
evidenceMisleadingSubdomainTitle: Tshiga tsha domain ṱhukhu tshi khakhisaho
evidenceMisleadingSubdomainDetail: Dzina ḽi fanyisaho tshumelo ḽi vhonala phanḓa ha domain i langaho {domain}.
evidenceLookalikeDetail: Domain hei i fana na domain yo ḓivheaho. U fana ndi tshiga, a si vhuṱanzi ha u kanda.
evidencePunycodeDetail: Adreseni i na punycode. I nga vha ya mulayo, fhedzi zwifanyiso zwi ṱoḓa vhulondo.
evidenceHttpDetail: Mafhungo a rumelwaho nga HTTP a nga vhonala ndilani.
evidenceSensitivePathDetail: Ndila i sumbedza uri siaṱari ḽi nga humbela mafhungo a tshiphiri. Khwaṱhisedzani domain nga u ḓiimisela.
evidenceDnsOkDetail: U ṱola ha zwino ho swika kha host.
evidenceDnsFailDetail: Host a yo ngo fhindula. Saiti i nga vha yo ṅwalwa lwo khakheaho kana i sa swikelelei.
evidenceRedirectChainDetail: Khumbelo yo tevhela u rumela huṅwe luthihi kana nnzhi.
evidenceCrossRedirectDetail: Adreseni yo rumelwa kha iṅwe domain ine ya ṅwaliswa.
evidenceRedirectDetail: Khumbelo yo tevhela u rumela huṅwe.
evidenceTlsFailDetail: HTTPS a yo ngo kona u khwaṱhisedzwa. Ni songo ṅwala mafhungo a tshiphiri.
evidenceIpHostDetail: Saiti i swikelelwa nga IP hu si nga dzina ḽa domain ḽo doweleaho.
evidenceRiskyTldTitle: Magumo a domain a sa dowelei
evidenceRiskyTldDetail: Magumo aya a shumiswa lunzhi kha mishumo ya u kanda. Othe a si vhuṱanzi ha vhuvhi.
evidenceDeepSubdomainTitle: Mutevhe wa domain ṱhukhu u sa dowelei
evidenceDeepSubdomainDetail: Mitevhe miṱuku ya domain ṱhukhu zwiṅwe zwifhinga zwi shumiswa u vhonala zwi mulayo.
evidenceSecretQueryDetail: Adreseni i vhea tshiphiri kha query. Nomboro a yo ngo vhulungwa.
evidenceProbeTimeoutTitle: U ṱola ha zwino ho fhela tshifhinga
evidenceProbeTimeoutDetail: Saiti a yo ngo fhindula nga tshifhinga.
evidenceHttpsLimitTitle: HTTPS a i khwaṱhisedzi vhuṅwe kana u fulufhedzea
evidenceHttpsLimitDetail: HTTPS i tsireledza tshikwama, fhedzi a i khwaṱhisedzi nnyi ane a shumisa saiti kana uri i a fulufhedzea.
evidenceScopeLimitDetail: Ri sekaseka adreseni nga mutevhe washu, u fana ha zwiga, DNS, u swikelelea na u rumela huṅwe. A ri rumeli URL kha tshumelo dza vhuraru.
evidenceUserBlockTitle: Mutevhe wa muthu wa u thivhela
evidenceUserBlockDetail: Host hei i kha mutevhe wau wa muthu (kateloso kana app). Saiti a yo ngo vhulunga mutevhe.
limitationFalsePosNeg: Zwiga zwi nga bvisa zwi si khombo, kana zwa pfuka khombo i re hone.
limitationNoContent: U ṱola uhu a hu sekaseki zwi re kha siaṱari nahone a hu khwaṱhisedzi nnyi ane a langa domain.
limitationIdentityNotSafe: U elana ha vhuṅwe a hu khwaṱhisedzi uri nyito dzoṱhe kha saiti dzo tsireledzea.
limitationNoThirdParty: URL a dzi rumiwi kha Google Safe Browsing kana kha dziṅwe tshumelo dza mbuelo dza vhuraru.

probeBlockedGenericTitle: Saiti yo thivhela u ṱola ho ḓiitaho
probeBlockedGenericDetail: Ho ṱanganedzwa HTTP {status}. Saiti yo thivhela kana ya fhungudza u ṱola uhu — zwenezwo a zwi vhuṱanzi ha u kanda. Lingedzani adreseni kha bhurauza yo doweleaho arali zwi tshi ṱoḓea.
faqCommonIntro: Phindulo pfufhi nga zwe buusdo ya ita na zwe i sa iti — dzi thusa phanḓa ha musi ni tshi fulufhedza mvelelo ya Ima.
proxyGuideLead: Blocking only applies to clients that use this HTTP proxy. Without it, the log stays quiet.
proxyGuideMac: macOS: System Settings → Network → your interface → Details → Proxies → Web proxy (HTTP) → 127.0.0.1 port 8080. Leave HTTPS unchecked unless you only need CONNECT host refusals.
proxyGuideWin: Windows: Settings → Network & internet → Proxy → Manual setup → Use a proxy server → Address 127.0.0.1 Port 8080.
proxyGuideLinux: Linux: set http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:8080 for the app, or your desktop’s Network proxy → HTTP 127.0.0.1:8080.
proxyGuideBrowser: Browser: prefer OS proxy, or an extension that sends HTTP through 127.0.0.1:8080. Do not install any MITM certificate — this product never decrypts TLS.
proxyGuideAfterBlock: Hosts were blocked. Set the HTTP proxy to 127.0.0.1:8080 or the log stays empty.
themeHeaderHint: Use the one Appearance button in the header (next to language).
